stories.title: The 12 MLB teams that most need to make a deal by trade deadline day
stories.summary: From the Yankees and Red Sox to the Phillies and Cubs, the sport's giants are among the clubs that need to take action ahead of Monday's deadline.

stories.title: Building the perfect trade deadline for Yankees, Mets
stories.summary: From another makeover in Queens to Mason Miller in the Bronx, here's a wish list for both New York teams.

stories.title: Tua out with 'flare up' as Falcons add QB Rush
stories.summary: Falcons quarterback Tua Tagovailoa is sidelined with what the team considers a "flare-up" of an undisclosed injury.

stories.title: Fever avoid addressing pro-Cunningham rally
stories.summary: Sophie Cunningham and Caitlin Clark were not made available to answer postgame questions about a rally before the Fever's 105-95 win over the Storm on Tuesday night in support of Cunningham's recent comments about transgender athletes.

stories.title: Infantino to FIFA members: Back WC plan for $40m
stories.summary: FIFA president Gianni Infantino set a Sept. 19 deadline on Wednesday for the 211 member federations to approve his proposed private investment plan, which would give each association access to up to $40 million in funding.
